scope: Reusable single-host service, current-time MCP assessment, two task profiles, two independent worker roles

native.information: Only the role's reserved context, response schema and its permitted gateway. No answer keys, fixtures, implementation, other roles or model environment. Workers author first outputs and record exact consumed IDs.

acceptance: Actual registered MCP discovery and acquisition; packet/explanation identities remain pinned
All selected claim statuses, IDs and individual assessment times preserved
Generic contested result retained instead of changing it to support
Correspondence mismatch stops assessment before acquisition
Separate real worker executions consume addressed canonical handoffs
All first attempts, missing or invalid outcomes retained with zero repairs
Unknown effects are not automatically repeated after restart
software_mode: Scripted command-client and process-interruption checks are separate from native execution
attribution: JSON and Lab share semantics and validation. This tests reusable workflow feasibility, not superior wire syntax or representative accuracy.
cost: Count actual contexts, registered assessments, MCP calls, observation acquisition/reuse and mailbox work. Native model identity/tokens/billing unavailable; no total-cost improvement claim.
publication: Current workspace implementation and saved setup draft are separate from environment publication
